title: Implement a Merkle tree with proof generation and verification
summary: Build a Merkle tree over a list of byte strings using SHA-256. Generate inclusion proofs for any leaf and verify them against the root. Include benchmarks against tree depth.
deliverables: Tree builds from a 10 000-element input in under 1 second
Inclusion proofs verify in O(log n) hashes
Property test: every generated proof verifies against its root
